reason: I'm not paying ₹99 a month for something when my channel earns nothing yet. Even if the analytics are useful, I don't know yet whether they'd turn into views, and I'd rather spend that money on editing help.
objection: Connecting my Google account, even read-only, to a tool I've never heard of, and then getting the Monday report by email when I live in WhatsApp and barely open my laptop.
would_change_my_mind: If it sent the report and video insights on WhatsApp, and the free 10 credits showed me one concrete idea from my own analytics that actually beat my usual views.
